reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000973 (the melody read from 000973a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 26); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. John Bacchus Dykes's dates (1823–1876) are from our page for the tune DIES IRAE (DYKES) (content/hymns/tunes/dies-irae-dykes.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1861. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000973a.nwc). The tune ends on G, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
